Maintainer decision (owner, live answer 2026-11-23): fix this red step of main with one small PR for the test file.

Ready to merge. The merging session read the diff (the author is a different agent): four doc-comment lines in `crates/app/tests/sinumerik_810m_post.rs`, the "Gate map" line with the modules that the file exercises. No code changes.

- Before: `gate_maps_tests::no_gate_map_names_a_moved_module_as_app` fails with `suites without a Gate map: ["sinumerik_810m_post"]` (seen on a trial tree of main `dac6a896b`). After, by the author: `cargo test -p xtask gate_maps`: 20 pass, 0 fail.
- The quick plan of the PR names the step `app suites: sinumerik_810m_post`. That binary was not run: a doc comment does not change it, and main did not compile when the author worked (fixed by `8f60c1f8e`).
- `git merge-tree` with main `8f60c1f8e` is clean.

The PR is flagged ready for the merge. Nothing is pushed after this flag.
